Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model
The unified Cubism model object API — the single recommended plane for plugin reads and writes of model state.

Recommended parameter path: 


 CubismModel model = context.cubism().model().active();
 Parameter angleX = model.parameters().find(new ParameterId("ParamAngleX"));

 float value = angleX.getValue();   // read
 angleX.setValue(value + 1.0f);     // single write: validated, undoable

For a batch of writes that must commit together or share one Editor Undo entry, wrap the work in CubismFacade.authoringTransactions() and call setValue inside its callback. Do not open an edit session (EditSessionService, incubating) or assemble command objects for ordinary value writes.

Several look-alike parameter types serve different semantics and are not interchangeable: ParameterSnapshot is an immutable read snapshot, ParameterDefinition is the payload for definition-level authoring (Parameter.updateDefinition(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model.ParameterDefinition), Parameters.create(dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model.ParameterDefinition)), OwnedParameter belongs to the detached OwnedModel plane, and EditParameterNode is a node of the incubating edit-session structure tree.
